title: Wikipedia — look anything up
$comment: A live-site example: it films the real Wikipedia, so there is no `set` to bring up — the beats just goto public URLs. Because it targets a DOM nolan doesn't own, `nolan verify examples/wikipedia.screenplay.json` doubles as a demonstration of catching drift: if Wikipedia moves an element, verify fails. Targets favour stable ids (#searchInput) and real section anchors (#Uses_in_nature).

beats.text: Wikipedia has an article on almost anything.
Just type what you're curious about.
The full article — live, not a screenshot.
Every section is a jump away.
Bioluminescence — how living things make light.
